source.heading: Chapter 1 — The Scientific Role of Machine Learning

requirements.statement: Machine learning is a family of methods for estimating useful conditional structure from data. Within Invariance Research it can construct representations, estimate outcomes and uncertainty, classify observations, discover recurring structure, and propose policies. It does not convert association into mechanism, prediction into realizable alpha, or model confidence into institutional authority.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: ML is scientifically warranted when the role is defined, simpler competitors are credible, temporal and selection biases are controlled, uncertainty is useful, degradation is monitorable, and the output improves the intended decision under realistic constraints. Otherwise the correct result may be that ML is unnecessary.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: A predictive model estimates an observable conditional relationship under a distribution and information set. An explanatory claim requires a separate mechanism or causal argument. A decision additionally requires utilities, constraints, costs, and authority. One model may contribute to all three, but the evidentiary transitions remain explicit.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: For a trade-quality model, the unit might be a registered entry opportunity rather than executed trades. Training only on executed trades conditions on the historical policy and can hide rejected or unobserved opportunities.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML02 — The estimand precedes the estimator** > Model search may vary estimators within a registered formulation; changing population, target, horizon, or utility creates a new scientific problem.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Return, direction, volatility, fill probability, slippage, drawdown contribution, and survival are different targets. A binary label such as “profitable” discards magnitude and depends on cost, horizon, exit, and path rules. A regression target may have heavy tails and changing scale. Ranking can be more stable than point prediction when only order matters.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: The target’s earliest availability time must be later than its full construction horizon. Overlapping horizons create dependent observations and influence split and uncertainty design.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: “Causal dataset” here means causally available for prediction. It does not imply that the dataset identifies a causal effect. Causal inference requires explicit assumptions and design.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Search workers receive training and validation partitions according to charter. Test or holdout access is an attributable event. Once exposed, that evidence cannot be treated as untouched for later variants. Repeated rolling evaluation may be operationally realistic while still accumulating selection information.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Rows whose label intervals overlap are statistically dependent even when their timestamps differ. Multiple rows from one episode or instrument can leak shared path information across random folds.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: No split rule is universally correct. The gap must follow the actual information overlap, not a ritual constant. Cross-sectional models may require time-blocked splits that keep all entities at a timestamp together.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: For row (i), record entity or event identity, observation time (t_i), decision time (d_i), feature-source times, label interval ([a_i,b_i]), label availability, universe membership, sampling weight, and group or episode identity. Fitted feature state references its training cutoff.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML03 — Splits follow information, not rows** > Two records belong on opposite sides of an evaluation boundary only when the training side cannot acquire outcome or fitted-state information from the evaluation side.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Every fitted transformer has a training interval, algorithm, hyperparameters, update cadence, state artifact, and output schema. Scaling, imputation, dimensionality reduction, vocabulary construction, and feature selection fit only on permitted training data. Validation and test rows use frozen state unless the registered online update policy permits otherwise.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: A pretrained representation brings its pretraining corpus, objective, cutoff, license, and possible protected-evidence exposure. “Pretrained” does not mean point-in-time safe.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML04 — A latent coordinate is still a scientific claim** > Learned representations receive provenance, temporal controls, stability tests, and limitations even when individual dimensions lack ordinary-language names.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Autoencoders, contrastive objectives, sequence encoders, and foundation-model embeddings optimize surrogate objectives. Their geometry may be useful without being a mechanism. They require baselines against transparent transforms, stability across seeds and periods, ablation, nearest-neighbor inspection, probe tasks, and downstream validation.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Monotonicity, sparsity, symmetry, equivariance, or known bounds can improve sample efficiency and auditability when scientifically justified. They are hypotheses, not free regularization. A wrong invariant can prevent the model from representing real change.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML05 — Complexity must identify its contribution** > A more expressive model is retained only when controlled comparisons show which decision-relevant property it improves and where that improvement fails.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Evaluation proceeds through a ladder: constant and empirical baselines; linear or generalized linear models; regularized and monotone variants; trees and ensembles; kernels; sequence or deep architectures; and specialized mixtures only when justified. Each step retains the same dataset and evaluation contract.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Regression can estimate conditional means, quantiles, scale, hazards, or full distributions. Classification estimates a probability only when its scores are calibrated for the intended population and horizon. Ranking learns order, not cardinal utility.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Future-fitted clusters cannot label past decisions. Online or rolling assignments use only fitted state available at the timestamp. Label switching across refits needs explicit alignment or new regime identities.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: A useful regime representation has identity, features, fit interval, assignment rule, update cadence, transition behavior, uncertainty, and semantic diagnostics. Hard labels are often less honest than membership probabilities or distances. Label names such as “risk-off” are interpretations that require independent evidence.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML06 — A regime is conditional on its representation** > Regime labels remain model-versioned assignments with uncertainty and cannot be treated as observer-independent states of the market.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Unsupervised outputs can form stratification variables, retrieval keys, candidate representations, monitoring summaries, or hypotheses about heterogeneity. They never authorize trading, quarantine, or capital changes by themselves.

requirements.statement: An anomaly score describes distance under a reference distribution or model. It may identify data defects, rare market states, or model support failures. These cases need separate dispositions. Anomaly does not imply opportunity.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: The primary strategy defines opportunity time, direction, horizon, stop, exit, and base size or abstention. The meta-dataset includes all eligible opportunities, not only executed winners and losers. Its target is conditional on the primary policy and downstream execution contract.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML07 — Meta-models inherit the primary policy** > Changing the primary opportunity definition, execution contract, or downstream action invalidates transport of the meta-model unless re-established.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Purging must account for primary-trade overlap. Randomly splitting episodes from the same market path can leak common outcome shocks.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: A meta-label never becomes a generic confidence score for capital. It is a calibrated estimate for a specific target, population, horizon, policy, and version. Book VII decides whether and how such an object may influence allocation.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Distribution shift can degrade both calibration and conformal coverage. [Podkopaev and Ramdas 2021](../../../bibliography/references.md#podkopaev-ramdas-2021-label-shift) studies classification uncertainty under label shift and develops reweighted procedures when target information is available. The institutional rule is to name the guarantee and its assumptions, never to say merely “distribution-free.”

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Abstention is a registered action with cost. The system can abstain when support is weak, uncertainty is high, inputs are stale, calibration fails, or operational constraints invalidate the prediction. Selective performance is reported against coverage; a model cannot appear excellent by acting only on a tiny favorable subset without accounting for selection.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML08 — Uncertainty claims name their guarantee** > A probability, interval, or prediction set is communicated with its reference population, assumptions, calibration evidence, and failure under shift.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: > **ML rule B6-ML09 — Cost models inherit routing selection** > A learned execution-cost estimate is conditional on the policies and market support that generated its training orders unless transport is independently established.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Admissible features can include observable spread, depth summaries, volatility, imbalance, recent trade flow, queue proxy, venue state, order type, size relative to liquidity, session, and measured latency. Each is point-in-time and venue-specific. Aggregated bars cannot support claims about order-book features they do not contain.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: The dataset should retain submitted, rejected, cancelled, partially filled, and filled intents with policy version and market context. Counterfactual venue or size labels require causal assumptions or simulation and remain separate from observed outcomes.

requirements.statement: Interpretability helps investigators understand model behavior, debug data and implementation, detect unsupported reliance, and generate hypotheses. It does not automatically explain the market process that produced the data.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.

requirements.statement: Continuous learning means repeated governed model releases. Online updating requires deterministic update order, bounded parameters, rollback, shadow comparison, and preservation of every model state. It is not unrestricted self-modification.

review.basis: Machine-assisted exact-text classification and chapter-level ownership mapping; domain review is required before an implementation disposition changes.
